crossRefs.note: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.
Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed…
The Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude…
Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all…
Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.
Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.
He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East.…
Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his foot in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and…
I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes…
A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and…
They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave…
So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.
Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is…
But the noble devises noble things; and he will continue in noble things.
Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!
They will not build and another inhabit. They will not plant and another eat: for the days of my people will be like…

people.name: East
people.line: A direction associated with invading armies and nomadic tribes.

translations.web: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you, and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.
translations.bsb: therefore I will indeed give you as a possession to the people of the East. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you. They will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
translations.kjv: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
translations.asv: therefore, behold, I will deliver thee to the children of the east for a possession, and they shall set their encampments in thee, and make their dwellings in thee; they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
